blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The stories told about artificial intelligence (AI) play a central role in shaping public understanding, policy debates, and expectations about technological change. News media are especially influential in this process. Using a cross-regional corpus of 12,924 English-language news articles about AI published since 2022, we examine how storytelling about AI varies across media systems in four regions: North America, China, India, and the Middle East. Leveraging large language models, we extract the implicit narrative lessons conveyed by each article---commonly known as story morals---capturing value-laden interpretations that extend beyond thematic content or sentiment. We find that North American AI coverage is uniquely characterized by narratives of caution, while under-emphasizing narratives of innovation and collaboration that are more prevalent elsewhere. However, this pattern is largely explained by a broader regional negativity bias in North American news sentiment, rather than by heightened concern about AI itself. Our findings bring into view the culturally conditioned nature of AI news narratives.
blocks.zh: 关于人工智能(AI)的故事在塑造公众对技术变革的理解、政策辩论和期望方面发挥了中心作用。 新闻媒体在这一过程中尤其有影响力. 我们利用自2022年以来发表的12,924篇有关AI的英文新闻跨区域文集,审视了北美、中国、印度和中东等四个地区媒体系统对AI的报道有何不同。 利用大型语言模式,我们提取每一篇文章所传达的隐含的叙事教训 -- -- 通称为故事道德 -- -- 抓住价值 -- -- 超越主题内容或情感的解释。 我们发现,北美AI报道的独特特征是谨慎的叙述,而忽视了其他地方更为普遍的创新和合作的叙述。 然而,这种模式主要由北美新闻情绪中更广泛的区域消极倾向来解释,而不是由对AI本身的高度关注来解释. 我们的调查结果反映了AI新闻叙事在文化上受到制约的性质。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The stories we tell about AI shape how individuals understand the technology’s role in society. This in turn can shape how local publics interpret the balance of risk and reward that accompanies this emerging technology.
blocks.zh: 我们讲述的AI的故事塑造了个人如何理解科技在社会中的作用. 这反过来又可以决定当地公众如何解释伴随这种新兴技术的风险平衡和奖励。

blocks.en: News media occupy a uniquely powerful position in the storytelling ecosystem of technological change ( Walgrave and Van Aelst, 2006 ; Boydstun, 2022 ; Wlezien and Soroka, 2024 ) . As recurring acts of sense-making, news stories help structure public attention by selecting which events count as “news” ( McCombs and Shaw, 1972 ) and framing them within moral and emotional registers of risk and reward ( Groves et al., 2016 ; Chong and Druckman, 2007 ; Iyengar, 1994 ; Cave et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 新闻媒介在讲故事的技术变化生态系统中占据了独特的强大地位(Walgrave和Van Aelst,2006;Boydstun,2022;Wlezien和Soroka,2024)。 作为反复出现的感官行为,新闻报道通过选择哪些事件算作“新闻”(McCombs and Shaw,1972年)和在风险和奖励的道德和情感登记册中加以界定(Groves等,2016年;Chong和Druckman,2007年;Iyengar,1994年;Cave等,2018年),帮助构建公众的注意力。

blocks.en: A substantial body of scholarship on AI’s portrayal in the news has emerged in recent years. Early work prior to the emergence of chatbots highlighted that AI coverage focused far more on themes of productivity and efficiency than issues surrounding governance or ethical concerns ( Chuan et al., 2019 ; Sun et al., 2020 ; Ouchchy et al., 2020 ) . When ethical questions have surfaced, they are often framed in practical or procedural terms rather than as moral debate ( Ouchchy et al., 2020 ; Bunz and Braghieri, 2022 ; Nguyen and Hekman, 2024 ) . This oscillation has been characterized as a shift between utopian “helping hand” and dystopian “Frankenstein” frames ( Cools et al., 2024 ) . More recent work has highlighted a growing negativity surrounding AI coverage ( Ryazanov et al., 2024 ) , with North American news showing higher relative negativity compared to other regions ( Ittefaq et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 近些年来, 在聊天机器人出现之前的早期工作强调,AI的涵盖范围远比围绕治理或道德关注的问题更注重生产力和效率主题(Chuan等,2019;Sun等,2020;Ouchy等,2020)。 当道德问题浮出水面时,它们往往被设定为实际或程序术语,而不是道德辩论(Ouchy等人,2020年;Bunz和Braghieri,2022年;Nguyen和Hekman,2024年)。 这种振荡被描述为乌托邦“帮助手”和“弗兰肯施泰因”框架之间的转变(Cools等,2024年)。 更近期的作品凸显出围绕AI报道的日益负面(Ryazanov等,2024年),北美新闻显示相对负面性高于其他地区(Ittefaq等,2025年).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Example of our story moral extraction process.
blocks.zh: 图 1:我们的故事道德提取过程的例子.

blocks.en: While prior work has made important contributions to our understanding of how AI is framed in the news, there are significant limitations to the data and methodologies used to date. Work in this area has been hampered by a lack of regional diversity, with only one large-scale study focusing on cross-cultural comparisons ( Ittefaq et al., 2025 ) . Several studies rely exclusively on qualitative analysis of small samples (N < < 1,000) ( Bunz and Braghieri, 2022 ; Ouchchy et al., 2020 ; Chuan et al., 2019 ) , while computational analysis has typically relied on methods such as topic modeling and/or dictionaries ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Nguyen, 2023 ; Cools et al., 2024 ; Ittefaq et al., 2025 ) , which have known limitations in terms of interpretive reliability ( Mantyla et al., 2018 ; Hecking and Leydesdorff, 2019 ; Rijcken et al., 2024 ; Pham et al., 2024 ) and ignore underlying narrative structures of news articles.
blocks.zh: 虽然以前的工作对我们了解新闻中对AI的描述做出了重要贡献,但迄今为止使用的数据和方法存在重大限制。 由于缺乏区域多样性,这一领域的工作受到阻碍,只有一项大规模研究侧重于跨文化比较(Ittefaq等,2025年)。 一些研究完全依靠对小样本(N < 1 000)(Bunz和Braghieri,2022;Ouchy等人,2020;Chuan等人,2019;)的定性分析,而计算分析通常依靠专题建模和/或词典等方法(Sun等人,2020;Nguyen等人,2023;Cools等人,2024;Ittefaq等人,2025;),在解释可靠性方面有已知的局限性(Mantyla等人,2018;Hecking和Leydesdorff,2019;Rijcken等人,2024;Pham等人,2024),忽略了新闻文章的基本叙述结构.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we combine large-scale cross-regional analysis with recent advances in computational narrative understanding ( Ranade et al., 2022 ) . Using a dataset of 12,924 news stories published since 2022 from four distinct regions—North America, the Middle East, China, and India—we apply methods for inferring the central values and lessons conveyed by a narrative, commonly described as story moral inference ( Figure 1 ). This approach has been validated across multiple narrative domains ( Hobson et al., 2024 ) , and has shown robustness across languages and cultural settings in capturing the higher-order lessons that readers infer from stories ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Wu and Piper, 2026 ) . Although related to media framing, story-moral inference targets a different level of narrative meaning: it seeks to recover the implicit evaluative point of view of a story, in effect asking, “Why was this story told?” rather than identifying its topics, themes, or issue-specific emphases.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们把大规模跨区域分析与计算叙事理解的最新进展结合起来(Ranade等,2022年)。 我们利用自2022年以来从四个不同区域(北美、中东、中国和印度)发表的12,924起新闻报道的数据集,采用了各种方法来推断一种通常称为故事道德推论的叙述所传达的中心价值和教训(图1)。 这种做法在多个叙事领域得到了验证(Hobson等人,2024年),并在语言和文化背景中表现出了强健性,可以捕捉读者从故事中推断出的更高层次的教训(Zhou等人,2024年;Wu and Piper,2026年). 虽然与媒体框架有关,但故事道德推论针对的是不同层次的叙事意义:它试图恢复一个故事的隐含评价观点,实际上是问“为什么讲述这个故事?” 而不是确定它的主题、主题或特定问题的重点。

blocks.en: Using this approach, we find that North American news about AI exhibits a distinctive narrative profile, emphasizing narratives of caution more strongly than those of innovation or collaboration. Importantly, this pattern is strongly associated with a broader negativity bias in North American news relative to other regions, suggesting the important role that culturally-inflected media conventions play in journalistic reporting. Our findings underscore that the cautionary narratives prominent in North American news should not be mistaken for a global consensus about the technology’s risks or social meaning.
blocks.zh: 使用这种方法,我们发现北美有关AI的新闻展现出独特的叙事性能,强调谨慎的叙事比创新或合作的叙事更强烈. 重要的是,这种模式与北美新闻相对于其他区域的更广泛的负面偏见密切相关,这表明文化上反映的媒体惯例在新闻报道中发挥的重要作用。 我们的调查结果强调,在北美新闻中突出的警告性叙事不应被误认为是有关技术风险或社会意义的全球共识。

blocks.en: 2 Data and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 数据和方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: For the purposes of our data collection, we utilized the Dow Jones Factiva platform limiting our queries between Jan. 1, 2022 (preceding chatGPT’s launch) and Sept. 9, 2024. Article sources were limited to 12 major English-language news organizations across four regions: North America, China, India, and the Middle East ( Table A1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了收集数据,我们利用了道·琼斯·菲克蒂瓦平台,限制我们在2022年1月1日(在ChitchGPT推出前)至2024年9月9日之间的查询。 文章来源仅限于四个区域(北美、中国、印度和中东)的12个主要英文新闻组织(表A1)。

blocks.en: As a first filtering step, we retrieved articles using two broad search terms (“Artificial Intelligence” OR “AI”) in order to capture the full spectrum of potential AI discussion. This resulted in an initial collection of 48,201 articles. To distinguish articles that genuinely focused on AI from those that merely mentioned it or triggered false positives (e.g. ‘Air India’), we tested four automated filtering protocols using GPT-4o against a reference set of 100 manually labeled articles: i) identifying AI as the “main character" or “agent/object of opinions," (ii) detecting AI mentions in the first five sentences, (iii) counting total AI mentions, and (iv) extracting three central topics of the article and determining whether AI appeared in this set. Our best method (iv) showed a weighted F1 = 0.85, which when applied to the full dataset reduced the total number of articles to 8,924.
blocks.zh: 作为第一个过滤步骤,我们检索了使用两个广义搜索术语(“人工智能”或“AI”)的文章,以便掌握大赦国际可能讨论的全部内容。 由此初步收集了48,201篇文章。 为了将真正侧重于AI的文章与仅仅提到它或引发虚假阳性的文章(例如 " 印度航空 " )区分开来,我们用GPT-4o测试了4个自动过滤协议,对照100个手动标注文章的参考集:(一) 将AI确定为"主要人物"或"代理人/意见对象",(二) 发现AI在前五句中提到的内容,(三) 计算AI提及的总数,(四) 提取文章的三个中心议题,并确定AI是否出现在本集中. 我们的最佳方法(四)显示加权F1 = 0.85,在适用于整套数据集时,将物品总数减至8 924件。

blocks.en: For comparison purposes, we then randomly selected 1,000 articles from each region (N=4,000) drawn from the rejected set of initially downloaded articles. This selection method helps guarantee the greatest alignment between our two primary article types (about AI, not about AI) while controlling for sections, length, industry focus and other confounding factors.
blocks.zh: 为了比较起见,我们从最初下载的被否决的一组文章中抽取了来自每个区域的1000篇文章(N=4,000). 这种选择方法有助于保证我们两种主要文章类型(关于AI,而不是关于AI)之间最大程度的一致,同时控制了部分,长度,产业焦点和其他困惑因素.

blocks.en: 2.2 Inferring Story Morals using LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 采用法学硕士法推断故事道德

blocks.en: For all articles, we prompted GPT-4o and Gemini-2.0-Flash to identify the following: (i) story moral statement in the form of a single sentence, (ii) 2-3 keywords distilled from the moral sentence, (iii) sentiment valence, and (iv) candidate industries mentioned in the article. (The full prompting notebooks are included in Appendix A4 .) Given the sensitivity of LLM outputs to model architecture and prompt variation shown in prior work ( Sclar et al., 2024 ; Baumann et al., 2025 ) , we generate eight prompt variations manipulating phrasing and position of article text. For each article, we then randomly select one prompt variation and submit it to both models. We then aggregate both models’ outputs as our final dataset. 1 1 1 The extrapolated rank-biased overlap (RBO) between the GPT-4o and Gemini rankings of keywords is 0.32 for the top 10 keywords and 0.40 for the top 100 ( p = 0.9 p=0.9 ) indicating low to moderate agreement.
blocks.zh: 对于所有的文章,我们促使GPT-4o和双子座-2.0-Flash确定以下内容: (一)以单句形式写出的故事道德声明; (二)从道德句子中提炼出2-3个关键词; (三)情绪活泼; (四)文章中提到的候选行业. (完整的提示笔记本载于附录A4.) 鉴于LLM输出对模型架构的敏感性,以及前作中显示的即时变异(Sclar等,2024;Baumann等,2025),我们生成了8个即时变异来操纵文章文字的用词和位置. 对于每篇文章,我们然后随机选择一个即时变异,并提交两个模型. 然后,我们汇总两个模型的产出,作为我们的最后数据集。 1个 1,关键词GPT-4o和双子座排名的推算出等级偏差重叠(RBO)为前10个关键词0.32个,前100个关键词0.40个(p=0.9个p=0.9个p=0.9个),表示低到中同意.

blocks.en: To validate moral keyword quality, we randomly sampled 100 AI articles and divided them into two groups of 50. For each group, two independent human annotators rated keyword relevance (0 = not relevant, 1 = moderately relevant, 2 = highly relevant) without knowledge of which model generated the keywords. We averaged the two scores for each article. Overall, a strong majority of keywords from both models (GPT-4o: 96%, Gemini: 82%) achieved at least moderate relevance, justifying their inclusion in subsequent analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了验证道德关键字的质量,我们随机抽取了100篇AI文章,将其分为两组50. 对于每组,有两名独立的人名注释员在不知哪个模型生成了关键词的情况下,对关键词相关度(0=不相关,1=中度相关,2=高度相关)进行评分. 每篇文章平均得分2分. 总体而言,两个模型中绝大多数关键词(GPT-4o:96%,双子座:82%)都至少实现了中度关联性,证明将其列入后续分析是合理的.

blocks.en: For estimation of article-level valence, we follow recent work and apply our randomized prompting framework to the generation of an article-level three-class sentiment framework: negative, neutral, and positive ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Debess et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了估计文章层面的能动性,我们跟踪最近的工作,并运用随机化的提示框架来生成文章层面的三等情绪框架:负面,中性,和正性(张等,2024;德贝斯等,2024).

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Distribution of moral keywords by region
blocks.zh: 3.1 道德关键词按区域分布情况

blocks.en: We begin by identifying the moral vocabularies that distinguish North American AI coverage from other regions, using log-odds ratios to compare moral keywords in North American stories with those in the rest of the corpus. We find that North American coverage disproportionately emphasizes skepticism, risk, exploitation, greed, and bias , while placing less emphasis on innovation-related values such as development, prosperity, progress, and competitiveness , as well as social values such as collaboration, community, and cooperation ( Figure 2 ). North American AI storytelling thus foregrounds risk while giving less attention to collective benefit and shared development.
blocks.zh: 我们首先确定将北美AI覆盖范围与其他地区区分开来的道德词汇,使用对数比来比较北美故事中的道德关键词和其余部分的道德关键词. 我们发现,北美的覆盖范围过分强调怀疑主义、风险、剥削、贪婪和偏见,而较少强调发展、繁荣、进步和竞争力等与创新有关的价值观,以及协作、社区与合作等社会价值观(图2)。 因此,北美AI讲故事有风险,而较少关注集体利益和共同发展。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Moral keywords most strongly / weakly associated with North American news stories.
blocks.zh: 图2:道德关键词与北美新闻报道关系最强/弱.

blocks.en: To clarify these divisions more sharply, we organize moral keywords into two overarching narrative types: caution narratives , which center on risk, responsibility, ethics, regulation, and harm, and innovation narratives , which focus on progress, opportunity, efficiency, and growth ( Figure 3 , see Appendix A3 for process).
blocks.zh: 为了更清晰地澄清这些分歧,我们将道德关键词组织成两个总体性叙事类型:谨慎叙事(以风险、责任、道德、监管和伤害为中心)和创新叙事(以进展、机会、效率和增长为重点)(图3,进程见附录A3)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Regional variation in the balance between caution and innovation narratives, which represent 50% of the total documents in our corpus.
blocks.zh: 图3:谨慎和创新说明之间平衡的区域差异,占我们机构文件总数的50%。

blocks.en: 3.2 The association of sentiment and cautionary AI framing
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 情绪和谨慎的大赦国际框架

blocks.en: One possible explanation for the distinctively cautionary character of North American AI coverage is that it reflects a unique concern about AI. Another is that it reflects a more general tendency within North American news to narrate events through negative frames. To distinguish between these possibilities, we fitted a multinomial logistic regression of sentiment (Negative, Neutral, Positive) within articles, including region, subject group (AI / not-AI), their interaction, and categorical controls for annotation model and prompt ( Table A2 ). We found that North American articles were significantly more likely to be negative in both groups: predicted probabilities were 33.1% for AI-focused articles and 40.8% for comparison articles, versus 12.8–14.7% and 14.9–24.5%, respectively, in other regions ( Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 北美AI报道的明显谨慎性的一个可能解释是,它反映了对AI的独特关注. 另一种说法是,这反映了北美新闻中较为普遍的倾向,即通过负帧来叙述事件. 为了区分这些可能性,我们在文章(包括区域、主题组(AI/ not-AI)、其相互作用以及对注解模式和即时的绝对控制(表A2)。 我们发现,在这两个组中,北美的文章很可能是负面的:以AI为重点的文章的预测概率为33.1%,比较文章的预测概率为40.8%,而其他地区的预测概率分别为12.8%-14.7%和14.9%-24.5%(图4)。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Predicted probabilities of negative, neutral, and positive sentiment by article content from a multinomial logistic regression including region, article subject, their interaction, annotation model, and categorical prompt identity.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 文章内容的负面、中立和积极情绪的预测概率来自多名物流回归,包括区域、文章主题、互动、注释模型和绝对的即时身份。

blocks.en: We next asked whether North American AI coverage remains more likely to convey cautionary morals after accounting for its more negative sentiment. For each of the 17,848 model–prompt annotations of only the AI articles, we combined all extracted moral keywords and coded whether at least one belonged to our cautionary framework. We fitted binary logistic regressions predicting this outcome from region, annotation model, and prompt, before and after adding categorical sentiment, again clustering uncertainty by article ( Table A3 ). We found that the North America–other regions gap declined from 15.1 percentage points before sentiment adjustment to 5.0 points afterward. The adjusted gap remained positive when each newspaper was omitted in turn (3.9–6.3 points) and in separate analyses of both annotation models. North America’s greater prevalence of cautionary AI morals is thus substantially reduced, though not entirely eliminated, when regional sentiment differences are taken into account and different sources and models are measured. This suggests that this cautionary framing is associated with a broader pattern of negative sentiment while also exhibiting a regional difference that sentiment alone does not fully capture.
blocks.zh: 我们接着问北美AI的涵盖范围是否在考虑其更为负面的情绪后,仍然更有可能传达谨慎的道德。 对于17,848个模型中的每个模型——仅是AI文章的即时说明,我们综合了所有摘录的道德关键词,并编码了至少一个是否属于我们的告诫框架。 我们安装了二进制后勤回归,从区域预测这种结果,注释模型,并在增加绝对情绪之前和之后迅速再次将不确定性按条款分组(表A3)。 我们发现北美其他地区的差距从情绪调整前的15.1%下降到后5.0个百分点。 调整后的差距仍然为正值,因为每份报纸反过来被省略(3.9至6.3分),并对两种注释模型分别进行分析。 因此,在考虑地区情绪差异和衡量不同来源和模式时,北美在警示性AI道德方面的更普遍程度被大幅降低,尽管没有完全消除。 这表明,这种谨慎的框架与更广泛的负面情绪模式有关,同时也显示出一种区域差异,而光是情绪并不能充分体现这种差异。

blocks.en: 3.3 Negativity Around AI Is Unevenly Distributed Across Industries
blocks.zh: 3.3 AI周围的忽略是不平等地分布在各行业

blocks.en: We examined whether the negativity observed in North American media coverage was concentrated in particular industries by calculating odds ratios (ORs) of positive versus negative valence for the top 15 industries in this subset of the data. Log-transformed odds ratios (log ORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) are shown in Figure 5 . Negatively valenced industries cluster around media and entertainment (along with law), with politics exhibiting the highest level of concern. Other industries such as healthcare, semiconductors, retail and finance were generally more positively portrayed.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了北美媒体报道中观察到的负面现象是否集中在特定行业,方法是计算出数据中前15个行业的正值和负值的概率比率。 图5显示了日志转换的概率比率(log ORs)和95%的置信间隔。 消极的有价值产业围绕着媒体和娱乐(与法律并列),政治表现出最高关注度. 其他行业,如保健、半导体、零售和金融,一般都得到更积极的描绘。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Log odds ratios (OR) of positive valence in North American news by industry for the top 15 industries.
blocks.zh: 图5:按行业分列的北美15个前15个行业新闻正值的逻辑概率比率。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: Our findings suggest that narratives surrounding AI in the news reflect not only local evaluations of the technology but also regional conventions of broader journalistic storytelling. Although North American coverage of AI disproportionately emphasizes cautionary values, this distinctiveness is substantially reduced when sentiment differences are taken into account. The greater negativity of North American coverage in general extends beyond articles centrally focused on AI, suggesting that cautionary storytelling belongs to a broader regional pattern. These findings suggest that public-facing narratives about AI are embedded within deeper media cultures of evaluation and affect, with potentially important consequences for how technological change is collectively understood.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,新闻中围绕大赦国际的叙述不仅反映了当地对技术的评价,也反映了更广泛的新闻报道的区域惯例。 虽然北美对AI的覆盖过分地强调谨慎的价值观,但考虑到情绪差异,这种独特性被大大地缩小了。 总的来说,北美报道的负面性更大,超出了集中关注AI的文章,说明警示故事属于更广泛的区域模式。 这些调查结果表明,关于AI的公开报道植入了更深层次的媒体评价文化之中,并产生影响,可能对集体理解技术变革的方式产生重要影响。

blocks.en: Our results help connect two strands of prior research on AI coverage that have often been treated separately: work documenting the growing negativity of AI-related news, particularly in North America ( Ryazanov et al., 2024 ) , and work emphasizing regional variation in media cultures ( Ittefaq et al., 2025 ) . Our analysis shows that the moral coloration of AI storytelling is closely associated with regional patterns of sentiment. In contrast to journalistic cultures elsewhere in the world that balance narratives of caution and innovation and collaboration, the entrenched negativity of North American news media strongly skews AI storytelling toward cautionary frames. That being said, our findings also show that narrative values, while strongly associated with sentiment, are not completely reducible to sentiment.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果有助于将以前关于AI报道的两部分研究联系起来,这些研究常常分开处理:记录AI相关新闻日益负面的工作,特别是在北美(Ryazanov等,2024年),以及强调媒体文化的区域差异的工作(Ittefaq等,2025年)。 我们的分析表明,AI故事的道德色彩与区域情感模式密切相关. 与世界其他地方平衡谨慎和创新及合作的记者文化不同,北美新闻媒体根深蒂固的消极态度强烈地歪曲了AI的故事情节,使其走向谨慎的框架。 尽管如此,我们的调查结果还表明,叙事价值虽然与情绪密切相关,但不能完全被贬入情绪。

blocks.en: Overall, our work illustrates the importance of cross-regional comparison in understanding how technological change is narrated. For journalists, the findings invite reflection on whether the moral lessons conveyed by AI follow from the evidence of a particular story or draw on familiar sentiment conventions. For policymakers, they underscore the need to distinguish the narratives prominent in one’s own media environments from a global assessment of AI’s risks and benefits. Recognizing these regional patterns can bring a wider range of perspectives into public debate.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的工作表明,在理解如何描述技术变化方面,跨区域比较十分重要。 对记者来说,调查结果要求思考大赦国际所传达的道德教训是来自某一具体故事的证据,还是借鉴熟悉的感情惯例。 对决策者来说,他们强调,必须区分自己媒体环境中突出的叙述和对大赦国际风险和益处的全球评估。 认识到这些区域模式可以将更广泛的视角纳入公共辩论。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations should be noted in conclusion. Our analysis relies on large language models to infer story morals, which introduces dependence on model interpretive priors. While prior work has shown that frontier models like GPT and Gemini used here align with human judgments and are often preferred in blind surveys with respect to story moral quality ( Hobson et al., 2024 ) , our findings are nevertheless limited by the semantic frameworks of models. Even though we control for model and prompt effects and focus on robust aggregate patterns, future work should further validate moral inference and the potential interpretive biases introduced by LLMs. In addition, our regional categories necessarily compress internal diversity within media systems, and our findings should not be read as exhaustive characterizations of national or cultural attitudes toward AI. Our sample was designed with cross-cultural comparison first and foremost in mind. Additionally, mediation analyses in observational settings do not establish causal pathways: they provide evidence consistent with sentiment operating as an important explanatory factor linking region and moral framing. Future work can investigate this relationship between systemic valence and narrative generation at the publication or article level more deeply. Finally, while we assume the distribution of news narratives is an on-going dynamic process that may change after our data cut-off, our findings also suggest a strong anchoring via regional sentiment distributions which may make the story morals of AI more consistent than expected.
blocks.zh: 最后应注意到若干限制。 我们的分析依赖于大型语言模型推断故事道德,这引入了对模型解释前科的依赖. 虽然先前的研究表明,在此使用的GPT和双子座等前沿模型符合人类的判断,并且经常在盲目调查中在故事道德质量方面更受青睐(Hobson等人,2024年),但我们的研究结果仍然受到模型语义框架的限制. 尽管我们控制着模型和迅速的效果,并注重强健的整体模式,但今后的工作应进一步验证道德推论和有限责任公司可能引入的解释性偏见。 此外,我们的区域分类必然会压缩媒体系统内部的多样性,我们的结论不应被理解为对大赦国际的国家或文化态度的详尽描述。 我们的样本的设计首先考虑到跨文化的比较。 此外,观察环境中的调解分析没有确定因果途径:这些分析提供了与情绪相一致的证据,而情绪是将区域和道德框架联系起来的重要解释因素。 今后的工作可以更深入地调查出版物或文章层面的系统价值和叙述生成之间的关系。 最后,虽然我们假定新闻叙事的分发是一个持续进行的动态过程,在我们的数据断绝之后可能会发生变化,但我们的调查结果也表明,通过区域情绪的传播,可以使大赦国际的故事道德更加一致。
